name: Nakano Otoha
source:
Nakano is a first year high school student in Suimei University of the Arts. She is a classmate of Daichi Miyahara.

She is an optimistic and kind girl, although at the same time, mysterious. Otoha was born in Quebec, and moved to Japan when she was 8.
